audit.finalCandidateBreakdown: 7 main + 4 boundary (null item, unsafe price, overflow, max safe)

findings.title: Intermittent rejection of a legitimate Codex repair by the narrow AST call allowlist
findings.precondition: Real Codex repair; model output uses a safe method not in the original eight-name allowlist.
findings.repro: Run PORT=4402 npm run test:browser on the pre-fix tree. One of five observed real-Codex runs ended with status=failed and error 'فراخوانی خارج از قرارداد تابع نمونه مجاز نیست' instead of awaiting_approval.
findings.expected: A legitimate pure repair reaches awaiting_approval; an unsafe repair is rejected.
findings.observed: 1/5 real-Codex runs rejected; the rejected source was not persisted, so the exact callee is unknown. Three direct agent samples and one repeat browser run were valid.
findings.fix: Expanded the pure-method allowlist (isSafeInteger, isFinite, abs, every, filter, map, etc.); closed the tagged-template bypass; added one bounded retry with the exact validator error; improved the rejection message with the offending callee.
findings.regression: tests: 'candidate contract accepts legitimate pure variants and rejects tagged templates', 'one validator rejection triggers a bounded retry'
findings.residualRisk: The retry adds one Codex call in the rare rejection path; the exact pre-fix callee remains unknown.

findings.title: SSE sent no response headers until the 12s heartbeat
findings.precondition: Quiet event stream (no new events) and a browser or proxy waiting for headers.
findings.repro: Log in, open /api/events, measure time to response headers.
findings.expected: Headers arrive immediately so the stream is established.
findings.observed: Headers arrived at 12,016 ms (pre-fix); the initial UI state masked the delay, but reconnect/status behavior could stall.
findings.fix: Write ': connected\n\n' immediately after writeHead.
findings.regression: tests: 'SSE flushes headers immediately and is unavailable to the tool capability' (post-fix measured 28 ms in the browser probe).
findings.residualRisk: None observed.

findings.title: Action approval was not re-bound to the action digest at execution
findings.precondition: An approved action document whose digest is altered (local store tampering) while the snapshot remains intact.
findings.repro: Approve a valid action, change action.digest to 64 zeros, call execute.
findings.expected: Execution is refused because the approved source digest does not match.
findings.observed: Pre-fix execution succeeded and deployed/incremented the project revision.
findings.fix: Compare approvedSource.digest with action.digest before execution.
findings.regression: tests: 'tampered action digest cannot execute'
findings.residualRisk: Requires local state write access; the check is defense in depth.

findings.title: Live reset was presented without explicitly saying it intentionally restores the faulty seed
findings.precondition: A liara-mode project and the 'آماده‌سازی نسخهٔ نمونه' (reset) operation.
findings.repro: Call resetProposal for a liara-mode project and inspect the pending action.
findings.expected: The approval card states clearly that the live service will deliberately be broken.
findings.observed: Pre-fix title was the generic 'انتشار برنامهٔ نمونه'; the risk text warned about a live change but not the intentional 500.
findings.fix: For liara mode, set title 'بازنشانی نمونهٔ زنده به نسخهٔ معیوب' and an explicit risk sentence.
findings.regression: tests: 'live reset is explicitly labeled as an intentional faulty deployment'
findings.residualRisk: The operation remains available (intended for repeat demos) and still requires human approval.

findings.title: Empty or malformed request body returned HTTP 500 instead of 400
findings.precondition: POST /api/summary with an empty body (live app or local demo route).
findings.repro: curl -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '' https://negahban-demo-4d0934.liara.run/api/summary
findings.expected: 400 with a client-error contract (INVALID_JSON / INVALID_BODY).
findings.observed: Live and pre-fix local: HTTP 500 {"error":"INTERNAL_ERROR"}.
findings.fix: server.mjs returns 400 INVALID_JSON for JSON parse/empty-body errors; the local demo route returns 400 INVALID_BODY for a missing body; the error handler preserves status codes.
findings.regression: tests: 'demo boundary distinguishes missing body and oversized input', 'fixture HTTP server rejects malformed JSON with 400'
findings.residualRisk: The live release 6ad9f90e still returns 500 until the fixed source is deployed with explicit approval.

findings.title: Numeric overflow returned HTTP 200 with null totals
findings.precondition: POST /api/summary with a price such as 1e308 or MAX_SAFE_INTEGER × 2.
findings.repro: curl -d '{"items":[{"price":1e308,"quantity":2}]}' https://negahban-demo-4d0934.liara.run/api/summary
findings.expected: 400 INVALID_ITEMS for a value that cannot be represented as a safe integer.
findings.observed: Live: HTTP 200 {"subtotal":null,"discount":0,"total":null}. Local repaired module pre-fix: the same null serialization.
findings.fix: Require Number.isSafeInteger for price, quantity, product, subtotal and discount sum; add three boundary cases to the protected verifier (10 total).
findings.regression: tests: 'independent verifier passes repaired candidate including held-out cases' (10 checks), 'naive missing-discount repair fails the new overflow boundaries'
findings.residualRisk: The live release 6ad9f90e still returns 200/null until redeployed with explicit approval.

findings.title: Global error handler flattened Fastify 413/415 to 400
findings.precondition: Request body over the 40 KB limit.
findings.repro: POST /demo/api/summary with a 50 KB JSON body.
findings.expected: 413 Request Entity Too Large.
findings.observed: Pre-fix: 400. Post-fix: 413 with a Persian message.
findings.fix: Preserve error.statusCode in the 400–599 range and map known Fastify codes.
findings.regression: tests: 'demo boundary distinguishes missing body and oversized input'
findings.residualRisk: None observed.

findings.title: MCP tool bearer could open SSE streams and consume dashboard slots
findings.precondition: Bearer mcp-key on GET /api/events.
findings.repro: Hold 12 SSE connections with the tool key, then load the dashboard.
findings.expected: A tool capability cannot consume the human dashboard stream.
findings.observed: Pre-fix: allowed by the global hook and the route; post-fix: 401.
findings.fix: Require a private human session in the /api/events route.
findings.regression: tests: 'SSE flushes headers immediately and is unavailable to the tool capability'
findings.residualRisk: None observed.

findings.title: Auxiliary dashboard text failed WCAG AA contrast
findings.precondition: Normal vision check of small muted labels.
findings.repro: Measure computed colors against white/panel backgrounds.
findings.expected: At least 4.5:1 for normal text.
findings.observed: Pre-fix ratios: stat small 2.65, event text 3.21, page heading 3.30, risk 2.36, approval expiry 2.32, footer 1.94.
findings.fix: Darker muted colors for the affected selectors; post-fix ratios 4.75–5.73.
findings.regression: Manual measurement (contrast.txt); no automated CSS contrast test.
findings.residualRisk: Some decorative/icon colors were not re-measured.

findings.expected: A claim of browser-driven repair should show repairInvoked=true or a prepared repair used.

findings.regression: n/a

findings.title: Sandbox blocks host files and network but permits subprocess execution if the AST validator is bypassed
findings.precondition: Direct snapshot injection (simulating a validator bypass).
findings.repro: Run a summary.mjs that imports child_process/fetch/fs inside bwrap.
findings.expected: No host secrets, no network; subprocess policy documented.
findings.observed: fetch blocked (TypeError); /home/.../.env blocked; execFileSync('/usr/bin/id') succeeded as uid=1000 inside the mount/network namespace. The product path blocks the import via the validator.
findings.fix: No product change: the validator blocks imports and the sandbox removes host mounts/network. Documented as defense-in-depth layering.
findings.regression: tests: 'sandbox cannot read host files or deployment credentials'
findings.residualRisk: A future validator bypass could run /usr/bin binaries inside the sandbox for up to 12 s; no host files or egress were reachable in this test.
